nodes.name: Webhook – Button Trigger1
nodes.notes: Zoho Deluge button calls this URL. Receives vehicle_id from CRM.

nodes.name: Respond to Zoho Immediately1
nodes.notes: Respond fast so Zoho does not timeout. Processing continues async.

nodes.name: Get Vehicle from Zoho CRM1
nodes.notes: Fetch full vehicle record using vehicle_id sent from Deluge button. EU data center = zohoapis.eu

nodes.name: Get Contact from Zoho CRM1
nodes.notes: Use the lookup field id from vehicle record to fetch contact email. Lookup field name is 'Kontakt'.

nodes.name: Build Form URL + Email Content1
nodes.notes: Builds personalized URL with vehicle_id as hidden field. Throws error if contact has no email — this is logged automatically by n8n.

nodes.name: Send Email to Customer1
nodes.notes: Uses Gmail credential. Replace with SMTP node if preferred. fromEmail stored in n8n variable — never hardcoded.

nodes.name: Update Vehicle – Anfrage gesendet1
nodes.notes: Sets Status=Anfrage gesendet, saves form URL and timestamp. Field API names may differ — check Zoho CRM field API names in Settings > Modules.

nodes.name: Wait 7 Days1
nodes.notes: BONUS: 7-day reminder. Waits 168 hours then checks if status is still Anfrage gesendet.

nodes.name: Check Current Status1
nodes.notes: Re-fetch vehicle to check if customer already submitted. If already Daten vollständig, skip reminder.

nodes.name: Still Pending?1
nodes.notes: Only send reminder if customer has NOT yet submitted.

nodes.name: Send Reminder Email1
nodes.notes: 7-day reminder — only fires if Status is still Anfrage gesendet.

nodes.name: Webhook – Form Submission1
nodes.notes: Zoho Forms calls this URL on every submission. Configure in Zoho Forms > Integrations > Webhooks.

nodes.name: Parse Form Submission1
nodes.notes: Extracts the 5 answers + hidden FahrzeugID. FahrzeugID is the key to find correct vehicle record. Field names must match your Zoho Form field IDs exactly.

nodes.name: Check if Already Daten vollständig1
nodes.notes: Fetch current vehicle status to handle double submissions gracefully.

nodes.name: Already Complete?1
nodes.notes: DOUBLE SUBMISSION LOGIC: If already complete, we still overwrite with new data (idempotent). Customer may have corrected a mistake — last write wins. This is logged via CRM note so team can see history.

nodes.name: Update Vehicle – 5 Fields + Status1
nodes.notes: Writes all 5 customer answers to correct vehicle. Sets Status = Daten vollständig. Both paths (first submit + duplicate) lead here — last write wins.

nodes.name: Add Note on Vehicle Record1
nodes.notes: Team notification via CRM note. Shows exactly what was submitted and when. Visible in activity timeline. Double submissions also logged — team can see full history.

nodes.name: Respond to Form1
nodes.notes: Acknowledge Zoho Forms webhook so it does not retry.

nodes.name: Log Duplicate Submission1
nodes.notes: Double submission detected — we still process it (overwrite). Last write wins policy. Team sees it in CRM note history.
